job.address: 27 Maple Ridge Dr., Saratoga Springs, NY 12866

estimate.project: Replace the existing south deck, north garage-side walkway, and porch-door stairs. All wood, decking, rails, posts, fascia, and stair components are pressure-treated. Build new 30” high x 40” wide descending stairs from the porch door. Install one sloping stair railing on the eastside (left as you look at the door from the outside).
estimate.duration: 15-18 days on-site. Monday-Friday 8/9am - 4/5pm (possibly some Saturdays). This schedule is weather dependent. We do not work during rain, sleet, or heavy snow.
estimate.crew: 1 general contractor full-time, 1 crew manager full-time, 1-2 laborers part-time

phases.title: Field verification, layout, and procurement
steps: Measure deck, walkway, angled edge, door threshold, and finished grades.
Confirm replacement limits and document existing house connections.
Verify beam spans, joist sizes, footing layout, and required approvals before purchasing.
Measure stair rise and lay out the 4-foot x 4-stairs, of the south to north descending stairs
Finalize takeoff, order materials, and arrange delivery and dumpster.

phases.title: Protection and demolition
steps: Protect siding, doors, windows, lawn, and access routes.
Remove existing stair railings, wide stairs, decking, and perimeter boards.
Remove existing deck and walkway.
Remove framing
Load demolition debris and secure the work area.

phases.title: Site preparation and footings
steps: Set deck and walkway elevations and mark support locations.
Verify 4 DP-50/50 pier locations, soil suitability, buried utilities, and pin clearance from foundations and obstructions.
Prepare shallow seats and position and level the four precast Diamond Pier heads.
Drive four 50-inch bearing pins per pier; install inspection plugs and caps and verify installation.
Prepare ground beneath deck for drainage
Install treated support posts and compatible galvanized post bases.

phases.title: Structural framing and siding
steps: Verify foundation material and install ledger flashing and five designed foundation attachment assemblies for the east-to-west framing, using substrate-rated anchors and compatible brackets/fasteners.
Set treated beams with supported splices and approved post connections.
Install treated joists, rim boards, and hangers to verified layout.
Frame the approximately 4-foot north walkway and connection to main south deck.
Frame the new angled yard-side edge and install blocking.
Install blocking and verify upper stringer attachment and lower bearing for stairs directly from the south door.
Build framing along the south wall from the west side of the stairs to the southwest corner.
Sort through the client’s available siding stored on site and select pieces in the best condition and suitable sizes for this area.
Fit and install the selected siding over the new south-wall framing.
Check level, fastening, lateral restraint, and framing before covering.

phases.title: Pressure-treated decking and perimeter finish
steps: Sort treated decking and select straight boards for exposed surfaces.
Install 5/4x6 treated decking with appropriate spacing and compatible screws.
Cut and finish the angled deck edge and walkway transitions.
Install treated perimeter trim/fascia and exposed riser or closure boards.
Treat field-cut ends and remove splinters and sharp edges.

phases.title: Four-foot stairs directly from south porch door
steps: Verify total rise, door operation and approved threshold transition; cut and install treated stringers for four-foot-wide stairs directly from the south door.
Install treated treads and risers at uniform dimensions.
Finish exposed stair skirts and the lower stair-to-deck transition.
Verify finished width and stair geometry before installing the railing.

phases.title: Single-left side stair railing
steps: Fit and install one Lovmor 36 in. H x 68 in. with Black Wrought Iron for 4 or 5 Steps Stair Railing Kit to the east side of the stairs (see samples of this rail kit on page 6)
Check rail attachment, spacing and finished ends.

phases.title: Final inspection and cleanup
steps: Check decking fasteners, posts, rails, stairs, and visible connections.
Complete punch-list adjustments and final inspection coordination.
Remove remaining debris and temporary protection and tidy disturbed areas.
Walk through the completed work with the client.
